title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance, chapter 14.04
requirement: Landlords, sellers, and rental agents are prohibited from discriminating against applicants based on protected categories, including source of income (such as Section 8). Selection standards must be reasonable and applied equally and uniformly to all applicants.
exemptions: 2-family dwellings where the owner lives on the premises
quoted_span: The Fair Housing Ordinance prohibits discrimination in real estate transactions such as: viewing or renting an apartment, terms and conditions of tenancy, refusing to reasonably accommodate a person with a disability if the accommodation would not cause an undue hardship to the landlord
